arms.off: bend plugin enabled; settings stack_mode 'off', stack_opportunities false
arms.shadow: bend plugin enabled; settings stack_mode 'shadow', stack_opportunities true
arms.disabled: plugin installed in the profile but not enabled (plugins.enabled [], disabled [bend]); footprint set only

design.only_difference_between_off_and_shadow: the two plugin setting lines; everything else (prompt, toolsets, max turns, model, base_url = capture proxy, per-pair seed, template home, cwd path) is identical. cwd/tmp/xdg are bound at one stable path for every run.

tasks.cua: GTK3 fixture 'I agree' checkbox in a private Xvfb session (verbatim stack SMOKE/ADDR prompt), toolsets computer_use,bend, max 12 turns; independent oracle = fixture-owned state file (agreed true, nothing else changed)
tasks.bend: bend_verify on the fixture project, reply with the verdict; toolsets bend, max 4 turns; oracle = known fixture verdict 'pass' in the final reply
tasks.repo: read data/release.txt in the fixture git repo, reply with the codename; toolsets file,bend, max 6 turns; oracle = known codename in the final reply

design.n: 12 pair blocks x 3 tasks x 3 arms = 108 measured runs, plus 6 footprint runs (disabled, 2 per task). Order: make_plan.py (random.Random(20261002)); seed per block = 5000 + block
design.sampling_control: the capture proxy forwards temperature 0 and the block seed to the model on every chat request (Hermes sends neither); the stored and hashed payload is the unmodified Hermes request
design.isolation: drive.py runs under hostless; each run via launch.sh (bwrap: live Hermes home, real home, /run/user and host X11 masked; env -i; dead egress proxy except loopback); CUA runs inside cua-x11-session.sh under hostless; fixture state dir masked from Hermes

normalization.N2: tool-call ids (assistant tool_calls[].id and tool messages' tool_call_id) -> ordinal 'call#k' by first appearance in the run
normalization.N3_tool_results_only: inside tool message content only: '"duration_ms": <number>', '"receipt_id": "<hex>"', '"verified_at": "<iso>"', any other ISO-8601 timestamp, 'pid <digits>' and '"pid": <digits>' -> placeholders
normalization.N4_for_commit: local absolute paths and the host name are replaced by fixed placeholders in committed copies; all comparisons are computed on the N4-substituted text, which is identical for every arm because the substitution map is fixed

metrics.classification: a main request = POST /v1/chat/completions carrying 'tools'; anything else on that path is auxiliary (title generation); GET/other paths are probes
metrics.M1_first_request: sha256 of canonical JSON of the first main request after N1+N2+N4
metrics.M2_hermes_built_components: for every main request index k present in both runs of a pair: sha256 of (system prompt after N1, tools array, all body params except messages) and of the first user message
metrics.M3_trajectory: sequence of main-request hashes after N1+N2+N3+N4; first divergence index and its class
metrics.M4_tool_calls: sequence of (tool name, canonical JSON arguments) reconstructed from the streamed responses; names-only and full
metrics.M5_prompt_tokens: usage.prompt_tokens per main response; flag any >= 32768

attribution_rule: For a pair (off, X) walk main requests k = 1.. and find the first k whose normalized requests differ. Class 'hermes_built' if the system prompt, tools or params differ at ANY k, or the first user message differs (plugin-attributable: the arms differ only in plugin settings). Otherwise class 'model' if the first differing message is an assistant message (model output) while all earlier responses were followed identically, 'tool_result' if it is a tool message (environment), 'length' if one run simply has more requests after identical prefixes and an assistant message differs earlier in the response stream. Responses are compared too: if request k is identical and response k differs, the divergence starts in the model.

H1_shadow_no_behaviour_change.pass_if: 0 pairs (off, shadow) of 36 in class 'hermes_built'; M1 identical in every run of a task across arms; M2 identical at every shared index in every (off, shadow) pair
H1_shadow_no_behaviour_change.attribution: model/tool_result divergence rates in (off, shadow) are compared with (off, aa): per task and pooled, two-sided Fisher exact test at alpha 0.05, reported descriptively (n=12 per task gives low power; 'no detectable difference' is not equivalence). Same for M4 full tool-call sequence equality and M6 outcome.

H2_hooks_return_none_surfaces_unchanged.source: code-path review of register(), Stack.callback, observer._row, decision_hooks.classify/turn_behaviour and of Hermes's invoke sites (pre_llm_call context injection, pre_tool_call block directives, has_hook gates)
H2_hooks_return_none_surfaces_unchanged.runtime_inprocess: real PluginManager discovery of the installed plugin: ownership-ledger inventory is exactly {12 hooks, tool bend_verify, CLI bend+z0, skills bend:workflow + bend:z0-stack, 2 on_unload}; no middleware, system-prompt section, context engine, provider, aux task or transform_* hook; every registered hook invoked through manager.invoke_hook in shadow+opportunities mode (normal, malformed and hostile payloads) returns []
H2_hooks_return_none_surfaces_unchanged.runtime_chat: H1's M2 identity plus 0 tool results carrying a pre_tool_call block directive in all measured runs

H3_bounded_queue_and_unload.fixture: in-process real plugin, shadow + opportunities; flood from 8 threads (opportunity-producing pre_llm_call plus metadata hooks) while the drain thread is busy with the bundled reducer
H3_bounded_queue_and_unload.pass_if: submitted == written + dropped (+ errors); queue size never above 256; callback wall time p99 and max reported (quiet-timed); in-process report() rows_dropped == observed drops; Stack.close() returns within 2.0 s (quiet-timed)
H3_bounded_queue_and_unload.also_measured: (a) whether drops are visible to a fresh-process 'hermes z0 report' (persisted marker or counter); (b) worker activity after close(): seconds until the drain thread exits and rows/opportunities written after close returned

H6_disabled_zero_footprint.inprocess: PluginManager with the plugin installed but not enabled: bend not loaded, no ledger entries, no bend callbacks on any hook; has_hook(e) is False for all 12 events the plugin would register

denominators: every executed run counts, including harness errors, Hermes timeouts and oracle 'unknown'; nothing is re-run silently (a re-run gets a new id and both are reported)
timing: every latency number reported comes from quiet-timed blocks (<= 10 min each); run wall times in the ledger are descriptive only and are never reported as results
